acceptance: Candidate must reduce validation RMSE by >=1% relative to both baselines; otherwise retain negative result.
One selected candidate evaluated once on final; promotion requires >=1% final RMSE improvement against both baselines and bootstrap upper bound of candidate-minus-baseline RMSE <0.
No supported slice (>=30 games) may regress >5% RMSE; computational caps and source reconciliation must pass.
artifacts: binding.json with release/dataset/source/transform versions, facts and exact game/row membership hashes
exclusions.json including every rejected game and reason
attempts.json with every config, seed, rows/dimensions, peak RSS, wall time and stop reason
baseline-predictions.jsonl and candidate-predictions.jsonl with role and immutable target keys
model artifact, dependency versions and reproduction command
baseline_recipes: Training pooled league points/possession with training home adjustment.
Training offensive-team and defensive-team ridge context model alpha=100 with intercept/home; unknown teams zero-centered.
calibration_recipe: None; point rates are regression outputs, not probability intervals.
candidate_recipes: Weighted ridge alpha=10 on player columns; unpenalized intercept/home.
Weighted ridge alpha=100 on player columns; unpenalized intercept/home.
Weighted ridge alpha=1000 on player columns; unpenalized intercept/home.
estimand: Exposure-weighted held-out offensive stint points per 100 reconstructed offensive possessions conditional on the recorded ten-player lineup; report fitted offense and opponent-defense coefficients separately.
exclusions: Exclude scheduled/nonfinal games, mixed phases, duplicate identity/event grains, quarantined games and incompatible source policies.
Exclude rows with unknown required target/exposure fields; absent rows are never zero.
Finalize complete game membership before splitting; never split one game across roles.
feature_recipe: CSR ten-player indicator row: five offensive +1 columns and five opponent defensive +1 columns, separate column namespaces, intercept and home flag. No player box prior, tracking, future roster or time decay. Weighted fit; penalize player coefficients only, unpenalized intercept/home; center reported offense/defense coefficients against training exposure without altering predictions.
input_gates: At least three reconciled complete seasons with admitted game identities, events, possession-policy-v1 and reconstruction/override versions.
Five distinct players per side, no gaps/overlaps and per-game team/player minutes, scores and possession exposure reconciled.
B20 retained database currently has zero stints: source_blocked.
input_grains: fractional offensive possession exposure and event-scored stint points
limitations: Historical reconstruction does not establish publication-time availability.
Registered design is not a trained model or a cleared source gate.
Latest seasons previously inspected cannot be advertised as unexposed final tests.
preprocessing_recipe: Fit vocabularies, centering, scaling and reference rates on training only. Unknown validation/final players get zero coefficient plus unsupported flag; no future identity or full-season prior enters an earlier prediction.
sample_policy: Fit positive complete exposure rows. Display player coefficients only with >=1000 training offensive possessions and >=1000 training defensive possessions over >=20 games. Include unsupported rows in held-out errors using zero unseen coefficients and report their share.
selection_metric: Exposure-weighted validation RMSE of stint point rate; compare both baselines using identical rows.
serving_policy: B26 artifacts are retrospective research only until separately promoted. Show fit/input/calibration horizons; forbid earlier-cutoff decoration by later-fit artifacts. No active points policy, forecast issuance or publication pointer changes.
target_recipe: For each offensive team/stint with exposure e>0, y=100*event-attributed points/e and weight=e. No duration-derived possession estimate. Offense and defense rows from one game share a split.
tie_break: Prefer baseline on equality; otherwise candidate order as listed. No final-test selection.
uncertainty_recipe: Seed 2501; 200 game-cluster bootstrap resamples of held-out errors with frozen predictions, percentile 2.5/97.5 differences. For coefficients report sign/rank variation across chronological training halves; no causal confidence interval.
units: points per 100 offensive possessions; defensive coefficient increases points allowed (lower is favorable)
